referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset includes the inspissation of lithium containing brine to a concentrated lithium brine by sun energy in the desert of Atacama (Chile)
referenceFunction.localName: Concentrated lithium brine (6.7 % Li), at plant
referenceFunction.name: Concentrated lithium brine (6.7 % Li), at plant

geography.text: Production site is in Chile, all data originate from an environmental survey about the plant in Chile. This dataset can be used globally, as this plant produces 70% of the Li2CO3 worldwide. Brasil electricity mix is used as proxy.

technology.text: The inspissation of the brine takes place in the desert of Atacama. The required energy for the inspissation is provided by the sun.

representativeness.uncertaintyAdjustments: Uncertainty is assessed using the pedigree matrix.
